checks: The auto-rotating affirmation bar and its pseudo-scientific copy are removed.
A static study focus tools bar replaces moving content, with no automatic live-region updates.
Focus view hides XP details and the footer, keeps all navigation visible, and persists across reloads.
The optional focus timer starts, pauses, resumes and ends on request without interrupting study.
The pause panel opens only on request, states honest non-medical boundaries and closes cleanly.
Working notes are restored with the saved practice draft and stay ungraded local text.
The focus tools bar and study views fit a 320 pixel viewport without horizontal scroll.
A finished session shows one polite break suggestion with a keep-going action and no interrupting modal.
limits: Installed Chrome against a local dev server; not all browsers, devices or assistive technology.
This is not an ADHD clinical evaluation; focus tools are ordinary optional UI preferences, not treatment.
Timer completion uses Playwright clock fast-forwarding, not a real 20 minute wait.
